summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, furnishing a news release dated October 1, 2026, announcing the launch of Fleet360, a fuel cell lifecycle services program, at APTA TRANSform EXPO 2026 in Chicago. The program is available with new FCmove-HD+ module sales in North America and includes FCcare+ coverage guaranteeing fuel cell module power output up to 250,000 miles. No financial terms, transaction, or corporate action is disclosed. CFO Kate Igbalode signed the filing. The event is a routine product and services launch, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle applies.
